title: trigger_interrupt_ability
description:
A player triggers an interrupt ability of one of their cards before its triggering condition resolves, whether or not they have the opportunity to act. Action and reaction abilities are triggered with `trigger_action_ability` and `trigger_reaction_ability`.

The engine does not apply card effects: the message only records which card is used. The player pays the costs and resolves the effects with other actions.

card_id.description: Card whose interrupt ability is triggered.
